# 4 Ezra Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Vision of the woman/Zion

---

**10:1** And-it-came-to-pass when-my-son-entered-into-his-wedding-chamber he-died; so-I-overthrew-all-my-lights, and-all-my-neighbors-rose-to-comfort-me: and-I-rested-quietly-until-the-evening-of-the-second-day.

**10:2** And-it-came-to-pass when-they-all-ceased-to-comfort-me that-I-rose-up-by-night and-fled, and-came-here-to-this-field, as-you-see.

**10:3** And-I-purpose-not-to-return-to-the-city, but-to-stay-here; and-I-will-neither-eat-nor-drink, but-will-continually-mourn-and-fast-until-I-die.

**10:4** Then-I-left-the-meditations wherein-I-had-been, and-I-answered-her-in-anger and-said:

**10:5** You-most-foolish-of-all-women! Do-you-not-see-our-mourning, and-what-has-befallen-us?

**10:6** How-Zion, the-mother-of-us-all, is-full-of-sorrow and-much-humbled!

**10:7** Now-mourn-especially because-of-her-mourning; be-sorry for-her-sorrow; for-she-mourns-most-of-all for-whom-you-all-mourn-so-greatly.

**10:8** For-as-the-field: so-Zion-her-husbandman-has-changed; and-as-the-fire: so-the-flame-of-the-glory-of-her-enemies-has-consumed-her.

**10:9** As-for-the-ornaments: her-inhabitants-have-been-taken-away; as-for-the-jewels: her-children-are-scattered-abroad.

**10:10** Her-daughters-are-enslaved: and-her-virgins-are-led-captive; her-chosen-ones-are-laid-low and-her-young-men-are-fallen-by-the-sword.

**10:11** What-more-can-the-bridegroom-offer-to-you than-what-I-have-offered-to-you? — or-what-more-can-you-lose-in-the-wedding-than-what-I-have-lost?

**10:12** For-behold, my-bridegroom-is-the-Most-High: Zion-is-Jerusalem; for-she-was-espoused-to-the-Most-High-before-all-others-that-were-ordained-to-dwell-in-her.

**10:13** And-he-has-prepared-for-her-habitations, and-from-the-beginning-he-sanctified-her with-glory as-the-place-of-his-own-dwelling.

**10:14** And-when-she-was-forsaken by-sin and-abandoned, she-grieved-greatly.

**10:15** Therefore-put-away-your-great-sorrow and-lay-aside-the-multitude-of-your-griefs; that-the-Mighty-may-be-gracious-to-you-again, and-the-Most-High-may-give-you-rest, a-respite-from-your-travail.

**10:16** Now-when-I-was-speaking-to-her — lo! her-face-on-a-sudden-shone-exceedingly, and-her-countenance-glistened, so-that-I-was-afraid-of-her; and-I-wondered-what-had-happened-to-her.

**10:17** And-behold! she-suddenly-uttered-a-great-and-fearful-cry, so-that-the-earth-shook-at-the-noise-of-the-woman.

**10:18** And-I-looked, and-behold: the-woman-was-no-more-visible-to-me, but-there-was-a-city-builded, and-a-place-showed-itself-from-large-foundations; then-I-was-afraid and-cried-out-with-a-loud-voice and-said:

**10:19** Where-is-the-angel-Uriel, who-came-to-me-at-first? for-he-it-is-who-brought-me-into-this-amazement; and-my-end-has-now-become-corruption, and-my-prayer-has-become-a-reproach.

**10:20** And-while-I-was-speaking-these-words, behold, he-came-to-me, and-looked-upon-me,

**10:21** and-lo! I-lay-as-one-dead, and-my-understanding-was-taken-away-from-me; and-he-took-me-by-the-right-hand and-strengthened-me and-set-me-on-my-feet and-said-to-me:

**10:22** What-ails-you? Why-are-you-troubled? And-why-is-your-mind-and-the-understanding-of-your-heart-disturbed?

**10:23** And-I-said: Because-you-have-forsaken-me! I-did-according-to-your-commands, and-went-out-into-the-field, and-lo! what-I-have-seen, and-what-I-still-see, I-am-not-able-to-tell-you.

**10:24** And-he-said-to-me: Rise-up-as-a-man and-I-will-instruct-you.

**10:25** And-I-said: Speak, my-lord; only-forsake-me-not, lest-I-die-before-my-time.

**10:26** For-I-have-seen-what-I-knew-not, and-I-hear-what-I-do-not-understand.

**10:27** Or-is-my-mind-deceived, and-my-soul-dreaming?

**10:28** Now-therefore-I-beseech-you-to-show-your-servant-concerning-this-bewilderment.

**10:29** And-he-answered-me and-said: Hear-me, and-I-will-inform-you; and-tell-you-of-the-things-which-you-fear, for-the-Most-High-has-revealed-many-hidden-things-to-you.

**10:30** He-has-seen-that-your-way-is-right: that-you-grieve-continually-for-your-people, and-mourn-greatly-for-Zion.

**10:31** This-therefore-is-the-meaning-of-the-vision:

**10:32** The-woman-who-appeared-to-you-just-now — whom-you-saw-mourning and-began-to-comfort —

**10:33** but-now-you-see-her-face-no-more, but-there-appeared-to-you-a-city-in-building:

**10:34** this-is-the-meaning — The-woman-whom-you-saw-is-Zion, which-you-now-behold-as-a-city-being-built.

**10:35** And-whereas-she-told-you-that-she-was-barren-thirty-years, [that-means]: because-there-were-three-thousand-years-in-the-world-in-which-there-was-yet-no-offering-made-in-her.

**10:36** And-it-came-to-pass-after-three-thousand-years-that-Solomon-built-the-city and-offered-offerings; then-it-was-that-the-barren-one-bore-a-son.

**10:37** And-whereas-she-told-you-that-she-nurtured-her-son-with-travail: that-was-the-dwelling-in-Jerusalem.

**10:38** And-whereas-she-said-to-you: My-son-coming-into-his-wedding-chamber-died — and-that-disaster-befell-her — this-means:

**10:39** after-that-also-happened-the-destruction-of-Jerusalem. And-whereas-you-saw-her-mourning-for-her-son, Zion-is-that-which-mourns-for-the-multitude-of-her-children.

**10:40** And-the-cause-of-her-grief-which-you-saw: this-is-that-which-Zion-has-been-enduring since-the-time-of-her-mourning.

**10:41** And-now-since-you-saw-the-likeness-of-her-being-built — this-is-because-the-Most-High-wills-to-show-you-his-city.

**10:42** And-the-reason-why-she-had-no-eyes: because-she-was-not-able-to-see-the-building-of-the-city.

**10:43** And-the-vision-of-you-who-saw-her-exalted-and-standing-firm on-a-great-foundation and-great-and-broad was-told-you — as-follows:

**10:44** She-appeared-exalted-and-standing-firm on-a-great-foundation because-the-Most-High-has-laid-a-strong-foundation-for-her-glory.

**10:45** And-whereas-you-saw-a-city-and-not-a-place-standing-firm: that-is-what-it-means: that-Zion-has-now-appeared-without-a-pillar, not-as-a-city, but-as-a-city-being-built.

**10:46** And-whereas-you-were-afraid-when-you-saw-her-face-on-a-sudden-shine-exceedingly: that-is-because-the-Most-High-has-revealed-his-city-to-you, and-henceforth-it-must-be-built.

**10:47** And-whereas-you-saw-that-she-suddenly-cried-with-a-loud-voice — lo! she-departed-from-you — that-is-what-it-means: God-speaks-not-with-those-who-dwell-on-earth-at-the-present; but-these-are-the-visions-reserved-for-heaven.

**10:48** And-whereas-she-showed-you-her-form-more-gloriously, and-whereas-she-appeared-on-a-place-of-great-foundations: all-this-means-what-you-see, and-what-I-shall-declare.

**10:49** Because-of-this-the-Most-High-showed-you-these-things, and-he-said-that-it-should-be-so.

**10:50** Therefore-I-commanded-you, when-you-were-in-the-field: that-when-you-had-eaten-the-flowers-of-the-field — in-which-no-human-building-was — the-Most-High-might-begin-to-show-you-these-visions.

**10:51** And-again-I-said: Stand-up and-I-will-show-you something.

**10:52** And-I-saw, and-behold: the-woman-was-not-seen-any-more, but-there-was-a-city-builded, and-a-place-that-was-exceeding-large showed-itself; and-I-said: What-is-this? And-he-said-to-me: The-city-you-see-is-the-beginning-of-our-kingdom.

**10:53** And-now-arise and-go-away: for-tomorrow at-night you-will-see-more; and-the-Most-High-will-show-you-great-things; and-he-will-strengthen-you-further.

**10:54** And-I-went and-walked-in-the-field as-he-commanded-me, greatly-glorifying-and-praising-the-Most-High; for-his-wonders, which-he-did-in-season, and-because-he-directs-the-times-and-the-things-that-pass-in-their-seasons.

**10:55** And-there-I-sat, and-did-not-eat-nor-drink, for-I-was-meditating-upon-him.

**10:56** And-it-came-to-pass that-after-seven-days, sitting-on-the-grass, my-heart-was-troubled-again as-before,

**10:57** and-my-mouth-was-opened, and-I-began-to-speak-before-the-Most-High, and-said:

**10:58** O-LORD, you-showed-yourself-to-those-who-had-believed-you, and-you-gave-them-comfort and-rest.

**10:59** Now-show-yourself-also-to-us, and-this-land-by-which-it-was-established: O-LORD, how-great-are-your-works! how-mighty-are-your-wonders! how-powerful-are-your-words! and-your-thoughts-are-past-the-depths!
